📜 Script Description
Dig the Backyard – v2.0

This script is a complete and polished UI-powered cheat for Dig the Backyard, built using the Fluent-Renewed library. It features a clean and modern interface with tabs for each function, smart toggles, keybinds, and more.

🔹 Main Features:

Auto LootBag pickup system (fast and reliable)

Auto Sell Ores (toggle & instant sell)

Auto Cake (Energy) system

Auto Upgrades (Jetpack, Shovel, Energy, Backpack)

Fully adjustable WalkSpeed & FOV

Smooth Fly mode with customizable speed

Noclip toggle with full collision restore

Auto Clicker (toggle or keybind)

Custom Keybinds for Fly / Noclip / Sell / Clicker

Custom Teleports (save & return anywhere)

ESP for Ores, Rooms, Players, Mobs, LootBags, Golden Statues & Zombie Spawners

Low Performance Mode for potato PCs

About section with version info

✅ Fully optimized, no crashes and everything is built with stability in mind.
